notes: The 3D icon set has its fog icon back. It was there all along — the set has a dense grey haze picture that was misread as another cloud, so v1.1.257 removed a perfectly good icon. Restored.
The 3D clear-night icon is the crescent moon with stars, and is exact rather than a stand-in as previously listed.
Showers in the 3D set now use a pale cloud with light rain instead of the sun-and-rain picture, which showed a sun during night-time showers.
All three sets now cover all ten sky conditions with a real image; only one stand-in remains, in Bronze, which has no moon-behind-cloud picture for a partly cloudy night and shows the cloud.
